role: Finite State Transducer morphological transformation engine for word inflection.
detail: Implements priority-union morphology: (1) direct-recall of irregular/previously-computed TRANSFORMS_TO edges, (2) procedural AST traversal with string binding, (3) persistence of computed results. Core classes: MorphologyResult (outcome dataclass with result_spelling, strategy, confidence), MorphologyExecutor (main engine). Key methods: transform(base_spelling, transform_type) executes FST union and returns MorphologyResult; _find_direct_recall queries TRANSFORMS_TO edges with priority for irregulars (is_regular=False) then high-confidence regulars (>=0.7); _execute_string_procedure traverses ProceduralTemplate AST via _execute_string_ast, resolving $WORD to input string (not ValueNode); _store_result creates TRANSFORMS_TO edge with is_regular=True, confidence=0.15; mark_defective flags computed edges as defective when guardian corrects errors. Confidence thresholds: 1.0 for irregulars, 0.15 for new procedural, 0.7 for recalled regulars. Procedure mapping: plural→proc:pluralize, past_tense→proc:past_tense, etc. Side effects: persists WordFormNode and TRANSFORMS_TO edges to graph via self._persistence.
gotchas: NotImplementedError for step_type='call' (executor unification deferred to future epic). No validation that $WORD is the only valid morphological variable. _store_result upsert logic: only creates new nodes/edges if not exist, but does not handle name collisions or overwrite stale results.
